comment:
* A delegate for android.os.Trace to allow testing static calls. Due to
     * limitations in Android Tracing (b/153319140), the delegate also records
     * counter values in system properties which allows reading the value at the
     * start of a tracing session. This overhead is limited to userdebug builds.
     * On user builds, tracing still occurs but the counter value will be missing
     * until the first change occurs.

variables.name: mShouldSetProperty
variables.comment: only when allowed, we check the current UID.

methods.name: public boolean tracingEnabled()
methods.comment: * Returns true if trace counters should be recorded.

methods.name: public void traceCounter(@NonNull String name, int value)
methods.comment: * Records the counter value with the given name.

methods.name: public void traceInstantEvent(@NonNull String track, @NonNull String name)
methods.comment: * Records an instant event (one with no duration).

methodNames: public void traceCounter(@NonNull String name, int value)
public void traceInstantEvent(@NonNull String track, @NonNull String name)
